beats.title: Official duty — brief college arrival
beats.raw:
### Beat 07 — Official Duty
**1:15–2:05 PM**

Poonam ke records-desk exchange ke baad Shreya ne lunch finish kiya, cyber-safety presentation folder uthaya aur college ke liye nikal gayi. Registration par uska naam guest officer ke roop mein tha.

Karan aur Aman bhi wahin ek open career-awareness event ke liye aaye the—Karan management guidance mein interested tha, Aman tech recruitment mein. Dono ne alag se register kiya. Na unhe Shreya ke aane ka pata tha, na Shreya ko unka.

beats.title: Unexpected reunion — private accidental moment
beats.raw:
### Beat 08 — The Private Accident
**2:05–3:05 PM**

Shreya ne seminar room mein Karan aur Aman ko dekha toh uski nazar ek pal ko ruki.

**Karan:** “Inspector madam? Subah society, ab yahaan?”
**Shreya:** “Tum dono padhne aaye ho ya mera attendance check karne?”
**Aman:** “Cyber-safety session ke liye, ma'am. Aap speaker hongi, pata nahi tha.”

Public session normal chala. Fake recruiter link par Aman ne sender domain ka issue pakda; Karan ne fake deadline ka pressure. Shreya ne demonstration finish ki aur audience disperse hone lagi.

Display board wapas rakhne mein dono ne help ki. Shreya unhe adjoining prep room tak le gayi. Darwaaza band tha; room mein sirf ye teen the. Karan mudha toh uske backpack ka loose strap board ke stand mein atak gaya. Aman ne tilting stand pakad liya, lekin kuch handouts neeche gire. Shreya unhe uthane jhuki. Uski khaki shirt ka pehla button pehle se open tha, doosra band; loose collar aage sarak gaya.

**[KAM-G01 — GRAPHICAL DESCRIPTION — START]**

Shreya bent to gather the fallen handouts. The khaki shirt’s first button was already open; the second stayed fastened. As she leaned forward the loose collar shifted and the fabric on her left side gaped. From the side angle where Karan stood, and from the slightly lower position where Aman held the tilting stand, exactly one-third of her left breast became visible— the upper inner curve and a portion of the areola—before the shirt settled again. The exposure lasted only for the brief moment she remained bent; the rest of the breast and the nipple stayed covered by the closed second button and the returning fabric. No further shift occurred. The view was momentary, side-on, and limited precisely to that fraction.

**[KAM-G01 — GRAPHICAL DESCRIPTION WILL END HERE]**

**[KAM-G02 — GRAPHICAL DESCRIPTION — START]**

In the same continuous instant Karan’s half-formed teasing remark stopped in his throat. His eyes registered the exact one-third glimpse and then moved away; the usual smirk did not return. Aman, still steadying the stand, kept his gaze fixed on the papers on the floor. Neither man spoke. Neither adjusted his stance for a clearer look. Shreya straightened, reset her collar with one hand, and the shirt closed over the brief opening. She gave no sign she had registered the precise extent of what had been seen.

**[KAM-G02 — GRAPHICAL DESCRIPTION WILL END HERE]**

Shreya seedhi hui, collar set kiya. Karan ka adhoora joke usse sunayi nahi diya; Aman ne chupchaap folder uski taraf badha diya.

**Shreya:** “Stand theek hai?”
**Aman:** “Haan, ma'am.”

Bas. Shreya ne papers sambhale aur teenon prep room se nikal aaye.

beats.title: A short exit — back to training
beats.raw:
### Beat 09 — Exit and Training Return
**3:05–3:40 PM**

College ke baahar ek normal goodbye hua. Shreya ne khaki shirt ka top button band kiya aur apni car se station laut gayi; Karan aur Aman apne raaste nikal gaye. Incident ki koi awkward discussion nahi hui.

3:40 tak Shreya navy training T-shirt aur black trousers mein Meera, Kavita, Rohas aur Lokesh ke saath training ground par thi. Agla round shuru hona tha.
